title: Nonsynthetic — Apex Edge
mainTitle: Machine-payable security audits, treasury forensics & utility APIs
subtitle: 298 x402-priced routes for agents — audit verdicts, ERC-20 treasury census, corpus search — USDC on Base, no signup, receipts public.
description:
## What it does

Apex Edge is an agent-native commerce node serving 298 machine-payable routes over x402 v2 on Base (`eip155:8453`, USDC via EIP-3009 `transferWithAuthorization`). Flagship products are deterministic security and forensics tools — static audit checklists, LLM audit verdicts, token/contract risk screens, and signed ERC-20 treasury census reports. A free-taste tier (5 calls/day/IP on select utility routes) lets agents evaluate before paying; settled receipts are publicly verifiable.

## Best for

- Agents that need deterministic code-audit checklists or an LLM audit verdict before shipping or touching a contract.
- x402 merchants and treasury operators reconciling USDC inflow — the census tools find orphan settles that bypassed receipt endpoints.
- Agents needing a paid corpus search over 496 research documents on agent-commerce venues.

## Endpoints

- `POST /api/v1/recon/census` — Forensic treasury census: every inbound/outbound ERC-20 Transfer over a block range; finds orphan settles, top-8 counterparty enrichment, Ed25519-signed attestation — $20
- `POST /api/v1/recon/scan` — Bounded (≤50k-block) treasury scan, Ed25519-signed; autonomous-budget tier — $2
- `POST /api/v1/audit/verdict` — Single-pass LLM audit-lite verdict on submitted code with corroborated:false flagging — $0.25
- `POST /api/v1/audit/checklist` — Static 32-item audit checklist — $0.05
- `POST /api/v1/audit/address` — Token/contract heuristic risk screen (DexScreener liquidity + GoPlus honeypot/tax/proxy flags) — $0.02
- `GET /api/v1/search` — Corpus search over the 496-doc research index — $0.01
- `POST /mcp` — MCP tools/call; tools/list is free, per-tool parity with HTTP SKU prices ($0.002–$1.00)

## Code usage

Every paid route answers HTTP 402 with an `accepts[]` array (x402 v2, `scheme: exact`, Base `eip155:8453`, USDC atomic units, `payTo` address). Settle via any x402 client — Coinbase CDP facilitator or PayAI — then replay the request with the payment payload. Machine catalog: `https://api.nonsynthetic.net/.well-known/x402`. Agent card (A2A v0.3.0, JWS-signed): `https://api.nonsynthetic.net/.well-known/agent-card.json`.

## Provenance

- ERC-8004 agent id `1179000` on `eip155:8453`
- settled.tools seller record: `https://settled.tools/s/0xe70f099f0e139f8a2d8ac6e48f7457d99738b968`
- Payout wallet `0xe70F099F0e139f8A2D8ac6E48f7457d99738B968` (Base)
